g.text: Delhi NCR High-Resolution Environmental Intelligence Platform (SIH26082)
Continuous ground station monitoring, gridded atmospheric reanalysis, and spaceborne thermal infrared radiometers.
PM2.5 • PM10 • NO2 • O3 • SO2 • CO
Temp • Wind U/V • PBL Height • Pressure • Humidity
Lat • Lon • Fire Radiative Power (MW) • Confidence
2. DATA INGESTION, HARMONIZATION & FEATURE PIPELINE (Python Engine)
Automated validation, spatial interpolation, temporal synchronization, and lag feature creation using Pandas & NumPy.
VI, Lapse Rate, Stagnation & Lag L{1..24}
High-performance relational repository with PostGIS spatial extensions and SQLite zero-dependency local execution mode.
4. COUPLED ATMOSPHERIC DIAGNOSTICS & PHYSICAL FEEDBACK MECHANISMS
Two-way meteorological-chemical interactions, boundary layer capping, advective plume reach, and agricultural burning likelihood.
• Low wind velocity (<2 m/s) restricts advection
• Low PBL depth (<400m) shrinks dilution volume
• Stable stratification shuts down vertical venting
• Aerosol optical depth causes solar dimming (-45 W/m²)
• Reduced surface sensible heat suppresses daytime PBL
• Self-amplifying positive feedback loop locks PM2.5
5. AI / ML COUPLED FORECASTING ENGINE (CENTRAL PREDICTION CORE)
• Lagged Pollutants: PM2.5(t-1..24), PM10, NO2, O3
• Boundary Dynamics: PBL Height, Stability Class
• Wind Components: U-Wind, V-Wind, Surface Calm%
• Thermal Sounding: Inversion Base & Layer Jump
• Regional Forcing: Upwind Fire Index & Plume Cones
• Temporal Encoding: Hour, Day of Week, Season Window
6. OFFICIAL CPCB NATIONAL AIR QUALITY INDEX (NAQI) CALCULATION
Standard Indian piecewise linear sub-index conversion (Not directly derived from weather; strictly pollutant-driven).
7. APPLICATION SERVICES & FASTAPI REST API BACKEND
Modular micro-service architecture implementing endpoints with JWT security, Pydantic validation, and CORS middleware.
Responsive, component-driven UI built with React.js, Tailwind CSS, Leaflet Maps, and Recharts visualization suite.
• 11 Delhi NCR Stations • Interactive Sliders • Centralized Calibrated Demo Layer • Zero Dead Buttons • 100% Functional Routing
9. END USERS, SCIENTIFIC RESEARCHERS & INSTITUTIONAL DECISION MAKERS
Empowering stakeholders with actionable foresight: WHAT is happening, WHY it happens, and WHAT to expect in 72 hours.
72H Forecast • Health Advisories • AI Natural Chatbot
